label: arcane bond
_source: Core Rulebook, Wizard: Arcane Bond and Familiars (legacy.aonprd.com/coreRulebook/classes/wizard.html, read 2026-10-05; d20pfsrd's familiar page cross-checked).

powers.name: Bonded Object
powers.line: Once a day, cast any spell in your book that you can cast, unprepared, through your $object (never an opposition-school spell). Casting without it in hand or worn needs a concentration check, DC 20 + the spell's level.
not_yet: Casting the unprepared spell through the object: the cast op asks for a prepared copy, so the daily use is counted here and the GM lets the spell through; the concentration check without the object is not rolled.

powers.name: Familiar
powers.line: Your $familiar familiar: its gift to you, and Alertness while it is within arm's reach.

not_yet: +3 on sight-based Perception in bright light: a check does not say what light it is made in yet.
+3 on sight-based Perception in shadows or darkness: a check does not say what light it is made in yet.
The familiar as a creature at your side (half your hit points, its own turn, share spells, deliver touch spells): it is not made in the scene yet. Alertness within arm's reach is not given either.
